        sandbox.set_material_properties(leg, restitution=0.1, friction=0.8)
        
        # Connect leg to torso
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(torso, leg, (leg_x, leg_y), type='pivot')
        joints.append(joint)
        
        # Connect leg to wheel
        sandbox.add_joint(leg, wheel_right, (wheel_right.position.x, wheel_right.position.y), type='pivot')
    
    return {"body": torso, "joints": joints}

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    joints = _get_joints(agent_body)
    torso = agent_body.get("body")
    if torso is not None and torso.position.x > 28.0:
        rotation_speed = 0.0
    else:
        rotation_speed = -1.0  # Reduced motor speed to avoid joint limit violations
    for j in joints:
        sandbox.set_motor(j, rotation_speed, max_torque=2000.0)
